Express's res.cookie() does not add httpOnly, secure, or sameSite attributes by default, so the cookie is readable by client-side JavaScript, sent over plain HTTP, and open to cross-site sending. The cookie carries an auth token, which is the case SEC-11 targets. The snippet alone doesn't show a global cookie-defaults wrapper, but nothing in the evidence indicates one is in place.
